changeSet.author: nexus-hbnml
changeSet.comment: (1) Create nexus.aspect_queue_rows_unscoped(): the number of rows nexus.aspect_extraction_queue holds across ALL tenants, counted with FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY lifted for the length of the count and put back as it was found (the migration role owns the table with no BYPASSRLS, so a count under FORCE sees zero rows on every tenant). Returns 0 when the table is already gone. Used by aspects-005-2's precondition and body; aspects-005-2 drops it. (2) Replace aspect_extraction_queue_collection_fk (ON DELETE RESTRICT, ON UPDATE NO ACTION) by ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE, so a table kept because it holds rows cannot block a collection delete, rename or move now that no engine code re-homes its rows. DATA EFFECT: none at this changeset (it creates a function and swaps a constraint; no row is read or written); the new constraint, later, deletes a queue row only when the collection it names is deleted, which is the row's own parent.

changeSet.author: nexus-hbnml
changeSet.comment: Retire nexus.aspect_extraction_queue (RDR-235 step B, nexus-bpikw): DROP TABLE, which takes its indexes, its sequence, its RLS policy and its two foreign keys (to catalog_documents and catalog_collections) with it, then DROP the counting helper of aspects-005-1. Guarded twice: a preCondition that the table holds zero rows across all tenants (counted with FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY lifted, see aspects-005-1), onFail="CONTINUE" onError="CONTINUE"; and the body itself, a DO block that counts again through the helper in the SAME transaction as the DROP and drops only at zero (Liquibase ends the precondition's transaction before the body runs, so the precondition alone leaves a window). A table that still holds rows is left in place, boot continues, and the changeset is NOT recorded as run (a precondition skip records nothing, and the body raises with failOnError="false", which Liquibase also does not record) so it is retried at every boot, never HALT and never MARK_RAN. The engine drains a kept table at start (AspectQueueDrain), so the next boot finds it empty. DATA EFFECT: DROPs nexus.aspect_extraction_queue only when it holds no row, so no row is ever discarded (managed service, 2026-11-03: 0 rows in all 5 tenants); the table's structure goes and the rollback recreates it EMPTY, so the effect is reversible for the structure and discards no data (the changeset only ever runs on an empty table); a table that holds rows is untouched.

rollback.sql: CREATE TABLE nexus.aspect_extraction_queue ( id BIGSERIAL NOT NULL, tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, collection TEXT NOT NULL, source_path TEXT NOT NULL, doc_id TEXT NOT NULL, content_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', content TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', retry_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, enqueued_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, last_attempt_at TIMESTAMPTZ, last_error TEXT, next_retry_at TIMESTAMPTZ, CONSTRAINT aspect_queue_pk PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT aspect_queue_tenant_col_path_uq UNIQUE (tenant_id, collection, source_path), CONSTRAINT fk_aspect_queue_catalog_doc FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, doc_id) REFERENCES nexus.catalog_documents (tenant_id, tumbler) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT aspect_extraction_queue_collection_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, collection) REFERENCES nexus.catalog_collections (tenant_id, name) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE ); CREATE INDEX idx_aspect_queue_status ON nexus.aspect_extraction_queue (tenant_id, status); CREATE INDEX idx_aspect_queue_fifo ON nexus.aspect_extraction_queue (tenant_id, status, enqueued_at ASC); CREATE INDEX idx_aspect_queue_doc_id ON nexus.aspect_extraction_queue (tenant_id, doc_id) WHERE doc_id IS NOT NULL; ALTER TABLE nexus.aspect_extraction_queue ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE nexus.aspect_extraction_queue FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON nexus.aspect_extraction_queue USING (tenant_id = current_setting('nexus.tenant', true)) WITH CHECK (tenant_id = current_setting('nexus.tenant', true));
